title: Static clause "I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities unless I'm in combat" is not implemented — enemy spells can choose Akali while she is not in combat.
expected: Running parseAbilities on Akali's rulesText yields only the move-to-battlefield trigger; the "I can't be chosen by enemy spells and abilities unless I'm in combat" clause produces no ability. The parser's only self "can't be chosen" pattern (riftbound-cards/src/parser/impl/effects-grant-keyword.ts:198-200) is anchored `...abilities\s*(this turn)?\.?$` so the trailing "unless I'm in combat" fails to match, and static-parser.ts:1305-1307 only handles the Alpha Wildclaw form. VEN cards are built from ven.json via parseAbilities (data/all-cards.ts:839-840, enrich-cards.ts:30) with no per-card override for ven-038-166. Engine-side, isUntargetable (riftbound-engine/src/abilities/target-resolver.ts:507-536) only honors printed keyword, unconditional static grant-keyword (condition === undefined), or meta.grantedKeywords — none of which exist for Akali — so enemy Hextech Ray can choose her out of combat.
observed: GET /moves?player=player-2 listed playSpell Hextech Ray with targets:[Akali]; executing it succeeded, chain item resolved and Akali took 3 damage (meta.damage=3, lastDamageSource=spell). parseAbilities(rulesText) returns only the move trigger — the conditional untargetable clause is dropped entirely (no static/restriction ability), and target-resolver isUntargetable() only checks unconditional Untargetable grants.
